fusions.name: Courier's Dispatch
fusions.desc: Throws a weighted dispatch that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for each stretch of ground you have travelled, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Postmark Stomp
fusions.desc: Stamps down on the target, which deals 13 damage, knocks it back 3 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Wrapped Puttees
fusions.desc: Wraps your legs in layered pages that absorb up to 18 damage for 8 seconds, and your movement speed rises 20% for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Annotated Mile
fusions.desc: Each time you cover a long stretch of ground, you note it down: your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
